body:
Villager Music Disc (2 Discs Mod)
Bring a fresh and fun vibe to your Minecraft world with the Villager Music Disc pack! This mod adds two unique custom music discs inspired by the iconic sounds and personality of villagers. Whether you’re relaxing in your base or showing off your collection, these discs add a lighthearted and immersive touch to your gameplay.
Each disc features carefully selected audio designed to match the quirky and memorable style of villagers. Simply insert the discs into a jukebox and enjoy a completely new listening experience while exploring, building, or hanging out with friends.
The mod is lightweight, easy to install, and fully compatible with most setups. It’s perfect for players who want to enhance their world without adding complex mechanics or heavy performance impact. Whether you’re a casual player or a collector aiming to complete every disc, this pack is a great addition to your game.
Features:
2 custom villager-themed music discs
Unique and entertaining audio tracks
Simple and lightweight design
Easy integration with vanilla gameplay
Add some charm and humor to your world with these villager-inspired tunes!
